title: Design-only stub: DynamoDB vector search store adapter
description:
## Purpose

Record a design-only stub for a DynamoDB vector search `VectorStore` adapter behind the same interface.

## Scope (design only; not built in this phase)

- On-demand table with a vector index (`VectorAttribute`, `Dimensions`, `DistanceFunction=COSINE`) and `label` as an `INLINE_FILTER` in the `SearchSchema`.
- `SearchVectors(TopK ≤ 100, SearchConditionExpression label = :L)`; separate search endpoint (`{acct}.search-ddb.{region}.amazonaws.com`); IAM `dynamodb:SearchVectors`. Results are eventually consistent; no pagination (16 MB max); no fine-grained access control.
- Risks: approximate search (`approximate: true` in the fingerprint), eventual consistency right after writes, account setup.
- **AWS facts checked on 2026-10-01** against official pages (design Appendix B): GA announced 2026-08-05; quotas 5 vector indexes/table, 4,096 dims, TopK ≤ 100, 18 inline filters. Pricing from a summarizing fetch and the minimum SDK version for `search_vectors` (not found): **re-check before building.**

## Definition of done

The adapter design (mapping onto `CreateTable`/`UpdateTable` vector indexes and `SearchVectors`, config keys under `store.kind: dynamodb`, IAM, risks, items to re-verify) is recorded in core docs or on this issue; no dependency, no AWS calls, no code path enabled. Cost: $0.

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.1, §4.5, Appendix B (DynamoDB vector search).
